# CS and AI: English Interview Preparation

**64 English preparation entries, 174 worked examples, 169 concepts, and 14 subject areas.**

Start with the complete area map, choose a subject, then open a linked question. Each question includes its source, input/output examples, reasoning, answer, complexity, pitfalls, and related concepts.

[English overview](README.md) · [Question index](INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS.md) · [Complete knowledge map](KNOWLEDGE_MAP.md)

Reviewed **2026-10-17**. Source publication does not establish current hiring use. Company samples, public practice problems, and documentation-derived exercises have separate provenance labels.

## Collections and language

The repository contains **100 sourced preparation entries**: [36 original entries](../INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS.md) and [64 English supplement entries](INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS.md). The original collection and chapter files retain their original Chinese or bilingual text. The English supplement and this 169-concept map are readable directly on GitHub.
